normative_evidence.quote: The numeric value in a BYDAY rule part with the FREQ rule part set to YEARLY corresponds to an offset within the month when the BYMONTH rule part is present ... It MUST NOT be specified when the FREQ rule part is set to anything other than MONTHLY or YEARLY.

rationale: Frequently accepted and silently reinterpreted as plain MO.
title: Numeric BYDAY with FREQ=WEEKLY (forbidden)
